"Thanks for trying out ActivityWatch for Android!" "It's not quite as matured as ActivityWatch on other platforms, but it's a great step in the right direction and we think it's ready enough to put out there!"
"

To get started, open the drawer menu in the top left and click on "Activity".
"

The next step for us is to get cross-device synchronization in place, but it might take a while since we really want to get it right."
"
If you're new to ActivityWatch, you should also check out the desktop version of ActivityWatch."
Allows ActivityWatch to read the URL and title from your browser.

To track your web browsing activity, LT Phone uses Android's Accessibility API to read the URL and page title from your browser while you browse.

This data is stored on your device. It is not sent to the app developers, advertising services, or analytics services. If you explicitly configure and enable self-hosted push, it is also sent to the server address you provide.

If you agree, enable LT Phone under Accessibility settings on the next screen. This is optional — the rest of the app works without it.

기기 이름 (서버에 등록된 이름과 정확히 같아야 한다)

서버가 등록된 기기 이름과 LT1 HMAC 인증을 지원해야 한다.
주소는 **https** 여야 한다. 이 앱은 평문 HTTP 를 127.0.0.1 외에는 막아 두었다 — 기록에 창 제목이 담기므로 망에 그대로 흘리지 않는다.
비밀값은 서버에서 안전하게 생성하고 앱과 서버에만 보관한다. 저장소나 로그에 넣지 않는다.
401 이 나면 서버가 사유를 그대로 돌려준다. \"시각\" 이야기가 나오면 시크릿은 맞고 폰 시계가 틀린 것이다.
